context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren plan a new system rollout.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business ops; rollout vocabulary (導入/業務/運営/維持/ユーザー) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新しいシステムを、導入したいと思う。
lines.en: I want to introduce a new system.
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 導入で、業務は楽になりますか?
lines.style: engaged young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、運営の手間が減るはずだ。
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ユーザーの声は、聞きましたか?
lines.en: Did you hear the users' voices?
lines.style: thoughtful young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ユーザーの要望を、導入に反映する。
lines.en: We'll reflect user requests in the rollout.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 導入後も、維持の費用がかかりますね。
lines.en: After rollout, maintenance costs arise too.
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 維持しやすい運営を、目指そう。
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 業務が、もっと滑らかになりますね。
lines.style: satisfied young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
